description: This Java interface defines the CustomValueDescriptor, which describes how custom data values are stored within the OpenMRS platform. It specifies methods for retrieving class names and configuration details related to custom data types and their handlers.

classes.name: CustomValueDescriptor
classes.description: An interface that describes metadata about how a specific type of custom value is stored, including class names and configurations.

methods.name: getDatatypeClassname
methods.description: Returns the class name implementing CustomDatatype for storing this custom value.

methods.name: getDatatypeConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration string for the datatype, which can be null.

methods.name: getPreferredHandlerClassname
methods.description: Returns the fully-qualified class name of the preferred CustomDatatypeHandler, or null.

methods.name: getHandlerConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration string for the handler, which can be null.
